title: avd-doc-findings/v1: what the docs consistency check found
description: Contract C13. Written by scripts/Test-DocConsistency.ps1 -Json (docs/docs-spec.md §6, §9) and read by avd-swarm's Scribe, which drafts fixes as PRs. says and truth quote only the repos' own public text. Tests in tests/Connectors.Tests.ps1.

sources.description: Each repo checked and the commit it was read at (7 to 40 hex characters).

id.description: Numbered per check in this document; not stable across runs.

key.description: Stable across runs (check, repo, path, says, truth; not the line), so a finding can be tracked or accepted.

line.description: 0 when the finding is about the whole file.

generated.description: true: the fix is regenerating a marked block or page with the generator, not a model.

confirmedBy.description: A judge finding a person confirmed; Scribe acts on a judge finding only with it.
